name: Find That Book HELD-OUT set
warning: HELD OUT. Do not tune rules, thresholds, prompts or few-shots on this file. Built 2026-10-24 by the head-to-head agent; targets are disjoint from golden.json and every research/05-08 query set (hand rows: disjoint from golden + hard sets, may share a work with the bulk synthetic sets).
how_built: Targets: random works from the mirror stratified by edition_count (popular >=300, mid 60-299, longtail 12-59), screened by gpt-4o-mini for "a real book someone would search by name", oversampling series, pen names, translations, children/YA, co-authored.

Canonical = most-edited work in the mirror with the same TitleKey sharing an author; every other such record is an acceptable split id. Live Open Library rank/edition checks are recorded in research/10-heldout/out/live_verify.json.
Queries: (a) llm_* role-played by Codex (gpt-6-astra) and gpt-4o-mini personas, vague ones removed by hand; (b) prog_* programmatic noise; (c) hand = written by the agent (tricky but fair).

scoring.top1: candidates[0].work_id in target_work_ids (kind author: any candidate author in target_authors by NameKey)
scoring.status: status in acceptable_status, and a match whose top-1 is wrong is a status error
scoring.match_precision: share of status=match whose top-1 is correct
